newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 27.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Gasoline imported from the United States may have an unsual smell but it is neither toxic nor harmful to car engines, Ivorian refining company SIR says; SIR, which usually meets all the needs of the Ivorian market from its own refinery, imported the fuel to maintain supplies during maintenance work.
- Security forces round up more young men in populous Abidjan districts for identity checks as part of crackdown on violent crime; police shoot dead bandit in Marcory suburb

- Cholera kills six people in region of Facobly in western Ivory Coast, health officials say; villagers put the death toll as high as 12. - Mini bus strike over municipal taxes in Ivory Coast's central
second city of Bouake ends; transporters agree to pay the taxes

- Publication director of Ivorian newspaper Le Populaire, Raphael Lapke, arrested over an article about the public prosecutor; investigators ask for source of a document published by the newspaper as part of the article.
